The '''Atravis system''' was a part of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories']] [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]]. Situated on the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], the [[Star system/Legends|star system]] was located in the territory controlled by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Atravis system suffered extensive civilian [[Death/Legends|casualties]].

==Description==
The Atravis [[Star system/Legends|system]] was located in the [[Atravis sector/Legends|Atravis sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Western Reaches/Legends|Western Reaches]] portion of<ref name="TEA" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> It was connected to the [[Shumavar system/Legends|Shumavar]] and [[Tosste system/Legends|Tosste systems]] by the [[Hydian Way/Legends|Hydian Way]] [[Super-hyperroute/Legends|super-hyperroute]], specifically the section which was [[Star map/Legends|charted]] by the [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] [[Freia Kallea/Legends|Freia Kallea]] and [[Banu Hydia]] in [[3694 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" />

==History==
[[File:AtravisHydianWay-TEA.png|thumb|right|300px|The Atravis system was located on a section of the Hydian Way hyperlane charted in 3694 BBY.]]
The area of [[Realspace/Legends|space]] surrounding the Atravis system was explored between [[5000 BBY/Legends|5000 BBY]] and [[3000 BBY]].<ref name="TEA" /> In [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], during the first campaigns of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Atravis system fell within the borders of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], and the [[Eighteenth Army|Eighteenth Sector Army]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] was charged with engaging the [[Confederacy military/Legends|military forces]] of the Confederacy in the system's vicinity.<ref name="TEGtW" /> Shortly after the acquisition of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ukio/Legends|Ukio]] by the [[Commerce Guild/Legends|Commerce Guild]] during that conflict, the Atravis system was featured on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Map/Legends|map]] displayed on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] at a facility run by [[Passel Argente/Legends|Passel Argente]], the [[Magistrate/Legends|Magistrate]]<ref name="AoI">''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]''</ref> of the [[Corporate Alliance/Legends|Corporate Alliance]].<ref name="DB Argente">{{DB|character|passelargente|Argente, Passel}}</ref>

The Atravis system suffered extensive civilian [[Death/Legends|casualties]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Its population around [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] numbered between one billion and ten billion.<ref name="TEA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Atravis system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square L-19.<ref name="TEA" /> ''[[The Clone Wars: Act on Instinct]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|webcomic]] authored by [[Pablo Hidalgo]] and released on [[StarWars.com]]<ref name="AoI" /> over the span of the 2009<ref name="AoI announcement">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/news20091001comics/index.html|text=New ''Clone Wars'' Web Comic Tells Original Tale}}</ref>&ndash;[[2010]]<ref name="Lethal Trackdown Ep Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode222.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Lethal Trackdown}}</ref> [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]] of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series,<ref name="AoI announcement" /> featured the first appearance of the system.<ref name="AoI" />
